title: Trutek accepts replies with an invalid protocol checksum
description:
Identity, position and movement replies validate size/opcode/payload but never the fourth-byte additive checksum, unlike the repository simulator protocol. A corrupted frame with a plausible target slot can be accepted and report success. Validate checksum before consuming all reply types; add malformed-checksum regressions. Source-contract confirmation, no hardware claim. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261101215425-fa40-complete-full-repository-audit-007.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
